author: Teotoniio Fontana — Architect
description: Performs complete backup operations for AWS EBS volumes and AMIs.
Includes full Phase 0 Global AWS Environment Discovery (Account, CFN,
Networking, Compute, Storage), with multi-region aggregation support.
Provides colorized execution header, multi-line config reporting,
responsibilities: Parse CLI + config for backup runs
Orchestrate discovery, snapshotting, full-volume imaging, and S3 manifests
Enforce simulation mode and safety checks before destructive operations
inputs: CLI flags (profile, regions, mode, run-id, filters)
outputs: S3 manifests and metadata per backup run
Exit code signalling success / partial / failure

items: Supports: all, *, explicit lists, and regex (e.g., '^us-', '^(us|eu)-')
